Theme

Nature & food

dewy adjective

also wet with dew

classical

Varr. RR 2.2.10: herba (Lewis & Short)
Col. 5.6.10: solum (Lewis & Short)

roscidus, roscida, roscidum

declension

wet with dew, dewy

From rōs. Lewis & Short and de Vaan leave the first vowel unmarked, and so does this record; the syllable is heavy either way.

Examples

  • et dūrae quercūs sūdābunt roscida mella

    and hard oaks will sweat honey like dewVerg. E. 4.30

See also dew, damp, morning, grass.

SourcesLewis & Short: roscidus

Vergil, Eclogae 4.30.
